d: In this video, Firstpost explains how Microsoft Office lifestyle reels featuring free food, snacks, office gyms and employee perks are going viral amid reports of a voluntary exit offer covering around 60,000 employees. From 'A Day in the Life of a Microsoft Engineer' to 'What I Eat at Microsoft Office', these viral social media videos are sparking debate about corporate culture, tech industry layoffs, employee benefits and job security. As Microsoft increases AI spending and invests billions in data centres, questions are growing about workforce restructuring and the future of technology…
